# GitLab — GitLab for Startups

Two-tier, two-year program for new customers: Seed stage gets a free Ultimate licence for year one and 50% off in year two; Series A/B gets 50% off in year one and 25% off in year two. All tiers capped at 20 seats.

### Tiers

Each tier has its own eligibility. A headline figure is usually the top tier, not
what a typical applicant receives.

| Tier | Amount | The vendor's wording | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Seed stage — year one | — | Free Ultimate licence for a year (SaaS or self-managed) up to 20 seats | No partner needed |
| Seed stage — year two | — | 50% discount on any tier; up to 20 seats | No partner needed |
| Early stage (Series A/B) — year one | — | 50% discount on any tier; up to 20 seats | No partner needed |
| Early stage (Series A/B) — year two | — | 25% discount on any tier; up to 20 seats | No partner needed |

### Not covered

- existing GitLab customers
- startups with no externally raised capital

### Notes

NOT INSPECTABLE: GitLab's public-facing program page and application form could not be read — https://about.gitlab.com/solutions/startups and https://about.gitlab.com/solutions/startups/join/ both return 403 to automated fetching, and every handbook.gitlab.com path 302-redirects to a projects.gitlab.io auth endpoint. The record is therefore built on the handbook source markdown served from GitLab's own gitlab.com repository, read at a pinned commit; the live page may differ. Funding caps are ceilings: Seed "up to $5 million in funding", Series A/B "up to $20 million in funding", both requiring externally raised capital, and both "New customers only." Support is excluded in year one for both tiers. Separately, https://docs.gitlab.com/subscriptions/community_programs/ states the program "provides GitLab Ultimate, plus 50,000 compute minutes per month for 12 months" without restating the tier split. apply_url is the address named in the handbook and was NOT independently confirmed to resolve. Imported from a verification sweep whose quote fidelity later failed audit in 13 of 22 sampled records. This entry was NOT independently re-audited, so the evidence quote may be a close paraphrase rather than the vendor's exact wording. Re-read the source before relying on precise phrasing. Re-confirmed 2026-09-16 on about.gitlab.com. Two tiers are published: Seed stage gets a "Free Ultimate license for a year (SaaS or self-managed) up to 20 seats" with up to $5M raised; Early stage gets "50% discount on any tier; up to 20 Users" for Series A/B with up to $20M raised. All offers are "New customers only".
